Recorded claim:
The new xpcshell test names tasks testEmpty, testOneRow, and testBranching. It checks parent index, level, open and empty state, cell text, invalid indexes, rowCountChanged deltas, and invalidateRow on open and close. The D208446 reviewer requested strict boolean assertions; the landed test uses Assert.strictEqual for them. This is a useful behavior matrix for another adapter migration, beyond a snapshot of rendered rows.
